fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Interconnect Attachment
fields.help: The name or resource link to the VLAN interconnect for this interface.

fields.label: IP Range
fields.help: The IP address and range of the interface.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: A unique name for the interface, required by GCE.

fields.label: Private IP Address
fields.help: The regional private internal IP address that is used to establish BGP sessions to a VM instance acting as a third-party Router Appliance.

fields.label: Project
fields.help: The ID of the project in which this interface's router belongs.

fields.label: Redundant Interface
fields.help: The name of the interface that is redundant to this interface.

fields.label: Region
fields.help: The region this interface's router sits in.

fields.label: Router
fields.help: The name of the router this interface will be attached to.

fields.label: Subnetwork
fields.help: The URI of the subnetwork resource that this interface belongs to, which must be in the same region as the Cloud Router.

fields.label: VPN Tunnel
fields.help: The name or resource link to the VPN tunnel this interface will be linked to.
